The treasure beneath him is measured in kingdoms. The confidence above it has been accumulating for centuries.

HAL seizes control of the surrounding systems, turning machinery, power and environmental controls against you.

There is no anger in the voice. No panic. Only the calm certainty that your continued presence is a problem to be solved.

Kronos tears the battlefield apart in a catastrophic eruption of molten rock, debris and primordial force.
Ancient stone and molten armor harden around Kronos, absorbing punishment that would destroy lesser beings.
The earth does not shake because Kronos is approaching. The earth shakes because Kronos is awake.

He looks cheerful. He looks harmless. Then a thirty-story marshmallow foot comes down through the roof.

He has conquered worlds, crushed rivals and survived wars that erased civilizations. You are simply the next obstacle.

The desert begins to move. Then the horizon opens into a mouth.
